description: This file is the core JavaScript implementation of the Magnific Popup plugin, a jQuery-based modal/lightbox library. It defines the plugin's core functionality, modules, event handling, and methods for opening, closing, and managing popups, including support for images, iframes, galleries, zoom, and retina displays.

classes.name: MagnificPopup
classes.description: Main class implementing the popup functionality, including methods for initialization, opening, closing, and managing popup content.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Magnific Popup plugin, setting up environment and event handlers.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a popup with specified options and content.

methods.name: updateSize
methods.description: Updates the size of the popup based on window dimensions.

methods.name: updateItemHTML
methods.description: Updates the HTML content of the current popup item.

methods.name: appendContent
methods.description: Appends new content to the popup container.

methods.name: parseEl
methods.description: Parses an element to create a popup item object.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Adds a group of elements to be handled as a popup group.
